paragraphs: Serving the Burlington community in our convenient Church Street location.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Welcome to our Burlington Church Street office! Reachable via Interstate 40/85, near Elon University, our Burlington location provides care for the Burlington community as well as for patients traveling from the nearby neighborhoods such as Graham, Mebane, Elon, and more. With our highly advanced technology and an experienced team, we provide the comfort and confidence you need for a healthy, pain-free smile!

Our modern, inviting space is filled with a professional, experienced team that strongly believes that dental care and treatment start with patient comfort. Therefore, we strive for our office and amenities to be designed with our patients’ health and well-being in mind. Situated in a suburban community that blends small-town charm with convenient access to the Holly Hill Mall, this location is accessible and easy to travel to. Our Burlington Church Street office stands out with its peaceful atmosphere, where patients feel supported and leave motivated to take care of their oral health with ease and comfort.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Burlington office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
At our Burlington office, we treat patients of all ages, from children to adults, providing dental care for all.
Our office provides free parking, and the parking lot includes wheelchair-accessible spaces as well.
We recommend scheduling dental checkups every six months, though if your needs require more frequent visits, our expert team will provide you with the care you deserve.
Yes, you can transfer dental records from your previous dentist to our Burlington office for continuity of care. Give us a call, and we are happy to help you through the process.
Yes! We have an amazing team of professionals ready to help you with your Invisalign® needs to discreetly straighten your teeth for a brighter, natural smile.
Take the first step towards optimal oral health. Contact our Burlington office to schedule your appointment or ask any questions about our dental services.
Fill out the form below and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.
Select a Location to schedule an appointment:
Call our Burlington Office at 336-331-7002, or use the form below to request an appointment.

Pooja Maheshwary, DMD
General Dentistry
Originally from India, Dr. Maheshwary was inspired to pursue dentistry at a young age after witnessing her uncle’s compassionate care for oral cancer patients in rural communities. She earned her Doctor of Dental Medicine degree from Tufts University School of Dental Medicine in Boston. Dr. Maheshwary is a gentle and empathetic provider who treats every patient like family. Her passion for dentistry is matched by her love for yoga and dedication to wellness. She is married to her husband, Aditya, and is a proud mother of two children, Aaryam and Prisha

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What ages of patients do you treat at your Burlington office?

At our Burlington office, we treat patients of all ages, from children to adults, providing dental care for all.

Is there convenient parking at your Burlington Church Street office?

Our office provides free parking, and the parking lot includes wheelchair-accessible spaces as well.

How often should I schedule dental checkups at your Burlington office?

We recommend scheduling dental checkups every six months, though if your needs require more frequent visits, our expert team will provide you with the care you deserve.

Can I transfer my records from another dentist to your Burlington office?

Yes, you can transfer dental records from your previous dentist to our Burlington office for continuity of care. Give us a call, and we are happy to help you through the process.

Does the Burlington Church Street office provide Invisalign® treatment?

Yes! We have an amazing team of professionals ready to help you with your Invisalign® needs to discreetly straighten your teeth for a brighter, natural smile.
